sloka: अहो महत् कर्म कृतं निरर्थकं न राक्षसैर्मन्त्रगतिर्विमृष्टा ।पुनश्च नास्त्रे विहते ऽस्त्रमन्यत् प्रवर्तते संशयिताः स्म सर्वे ।। ५.४८.५१।।।।
transliteration: aho mahat karma kṛtaṁ nirarthakaṁ na rākṣasairmantragatirvimṛṣṭā ।punaśca nāstre vihate 'stramanyat pravartate saṁśayitāḥ sma sarve ।। 5.48.51।।।।

translations.english: Though binding and dragging by the ogres had hurt Hanuman, he on his part did not know that he had been released from Brahmastra.
